contracts.checkpoint_time: All exact checkpoint timestamps unavailable in consumed metadata; observation timestamps are not checkpoint creation times.
contracts.duplicate_rule: Checkpoint identity is global checkpoint SHA. Distinct population/report evaluations remain separate rows; duplicates are marked globally and within population. Repeated observations remain separate and never claim unique checkpoints.
contracts.fixed32_scope: Historical task correctness and protocol validity are separate from LM NLL/PPL; zero protocol-valid outputs prevent isolating reasoning.
contracts.missing: JSON null / empty CSV means unavailable or unrun, never zero. No live token count inferred from GPU occupancy or wall time.
contracts.stage2_freeze: The earlier terminal broader LM and fixed32 evaluations remain separate from V4. Checkpoint creation times are unavailable. Fixed32 evaluator-local LM-not-run fields do not negate the separate completed CFR and broader LM evaluations.

units.processed_ids: training token IDs processed including masked positions
units.total_nll_nats_derived: mean NLL multiplied by population denominator, algebraically derived

v4.baseline: Repeated evaluation of exactly the parent weights, not a new unique checkpoint or reasoning benchmark. Its observation timestamp is not an exact checkpoint or evaluation creation time.
v4.budget: Charged-cap clock = parent physical valid labels + separate 15240080 failed reserved labels + V4 charged valid labels; cap 1000000000.
v4.checkpoint569: Intermediate loop through checkpoint569; evaluation hooks include parent baseline plus checkpoint. Full boundary hooks included; model load excluded. No final-run or GPU-kernel timing claim.
v4.claims: No perplexity target, capacity claim, or reasoning conclusion is inferred.
v4.frozen_panels: Historical broad and fixed32 panels remain unchanged; parent broad PPL14.631154356930713 and fixed32 0/32 are not fresh V4 measurements.
v4.missing: JSON null and empty CSV cells mean unavailable or unrun, never zero.
v4.processed_ids: Derived from fixed 1024 IDs per microbatch and 32 microbatches per completed update; valid labels retain observed mask-aware counts.
v4.progress: Live completed-update exposure is not saved-checkpoint exposure. Charged microbatches include unfinished accumulation.
v4.refresh_saved: Observer saved hints do not create evaluated points. A saved checkpoint needs separately pinned receipt and evaluation before the history can add its CFR value.
v4.throughput: Interval rates divide changes between two validated observations by their actual UTC wall-time delta. They include all elapsed overhead in that interval and are not GPU-kernel rates. First interval is unavailable. Startup-inclusive charged rate divides total V4 charged labels by elapsed guard time and is a separate metric.
v4.timings: Live progress rows have no timing receipt; their overhead fields remain null. Separate intermediate_run_timings records measured full-boundary hooks through checkpoint569, not final-run overhead.
